_comment: Optional per-project model overrides. Same shape as the library default (agents/models.json); list only what you change, e.g. {"claude": {"strong": "sonnet"}, "codex": {"strong": "gpt-6.1-sol"}}. Reasoning effort works the same way under "effort": {"claude": {"standard": "medium"}, "roles": {"fiction-writer": "xhigh"}} (a role entry wins over a tier entry; claude accepts low, medium, high, xhigh, max; codex accepts low, medium, high, xhigh; null inherits the session). Re-run the bootstrapper update to apply.
